# Hack@Davidson

> Hack@Davidson is a student-run organization at Davidson College building a community of makers across every major. The club runs Davidson's annual hackathon, plus workshops, build nights, and tech talks all year, and is free and open to any Davidson student.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hackatdavidson.com/): About the club, programs, gallery, projects built by members, team, and sponsors.
- [Sponsor Hack@Davidson](https://hackatdavidson.com/sponsor): Sponsorship tiers, benefits, and how to fund the hackathon through Davidson College's giving form.

## Notes

- The next hackathon, Hack@Davidson 2027, is planned for February 2027; exact dates are not yet set.
- Contact: hack@davidson.edu
